beats.text: 📢 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!" (Hunt an animal today for a reward.)
"The sick need tending — triage tents, broth, boiled water. Or we tighten our belts and wait it out. Or the hale hunt while the sick lie still."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)

Olivia leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about ducks in a row. Break the line. The line is one animal, but only while it's whole. Strike a duck that ISN'T the head and the line splits — both halves hunt on their own and the formation dies. Break the line, then thin the pieces."
